mechanism: Chlorthalidone may increase photosensitivity risk when combined with minocycline, a tetracycline known to cause photosensitive reactions; additionally, thiazide diuretics can affect renal function and potentially alter minocycline clearance.
action: Advise patients to use strict photoprotection (sunscreen, protective clothing) during concurrent use and monitor renal function periodically, as chlorthalidone-induced volume depletion could theoretically increase minocycline concentration.
